text:
maya: FYI customer reported promo code applied to their Private account credits instead of Dedicated capacity. Account id acct_12345. They applied via Console yesterday and now their dedicated cluster shows 0 credits and calls are failing with 402. Screenshot: https://uploads.redwood/acct_12345/promo-screenshot.png

devon: can you drop the promo code value and the exact time they applied? i’ll check ledger entries and scope flags.

maya: promo: PROMO-APR26-50K, applied 2026-03-09T18:42:10Z per customer. customer says console showed a "deployment type" dropdown and they picked "Private" by mistake. they want credits moved to Dedicated or a replacement promo.

liam: curious — if console incorrectly maps the dropdown we should capture the payload. maya: can you paste the request body the customer saw (screenshot of network tab) or the server logs?

maya: customer sent this snippet from their browser devtools (redacted):

```json
{
  "promo_code": "PROMO-APR26-50K",
  "account_id": "acct_12345",
  "selected_deployment": "private",
  "applied_at": "2026-03-09T18:42:10Z"
}
```

liam: ok — looks like the front-end sent selected_deployment=private. need to confirm backend enforce scope. ops-bot, any recent changes to promo validation or the apply endpoint?

ops-bot: deploy 2026-03-01 03:12:11 UTC to promo-service. No schema changes flagged. Last migration: promo_scope_flags v2 on 2026-02-25.

jordan: billing-side we can do a manual transfer of credit units from Private bucket -> Dedicated if promo is eligible. devon, is this promo region/sku-restricted?

devon: PROMO-APR26-50K has scopes: ["private_only"] in the ledger (looks like the promo was intentionally minted for Private deployments). but customer claims they were told the promo is for Dedicated. we need to verify sales email. i'm going to pull ledger row and the issuance trace.

maya: customer attached sales email claiming Dedicated credits, cc sales rep. forwarding to you.

devon: internal note: holding on manual transfer until we confirm sales authorization. if sales confirms dedicated entitlement we can re-assign. creating support ticket: INC-2026-482.

liam: separate bug possibility: if console UX only shows "Private/Dedicated" options but the promo dropdown doesn't filter by promo scope, that can cause confusion. i'll open an ENG bug and label P0-ux.

jordan: if finance approves one-off we can run this command to reassign credits (internal api):

```bash
curl -X POST "https://billing.internal.redwood/v1/credits/adjust" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $BILLING_TOKEN" \
  -d '{"from_account":"acct_ledger_private","to_account":"acct_12345_dedicated","promo_code":"PROMO-APR26-50K","amount":50000,"reason":"sales-authenticated correction - INC-2026-482"}'
```

maya: replied to customer with expected timeline: waiting on sales confirmation + finance approval. customer asked if there's a temporary workaround because their dedicated cluster is blocked.

liam: for immediate unblock we can grant temporary usage credits charged to Redwood while we sort transfer (note: tracked as goodwill). ops-bot, can you provision a 72h emergency grant of 10k tokens to acct_12345 dedicated pool?

ops-bot: emergency grant request accepted. grant id EG-2026-77, expires 2026-03-12T11:00:00Z.

devon: sales confirmed via email: promo was intended for Dedicated. proceeding with manual transfer. posting ledger tx refs when done.

finance-bot: adjustment queued. TX_REF: TX-987654321. Expected posting within 10m.

maya: finance confirmed and customer notified. closing loop with sales. customer is back online, thanks all. :tada:

liam: created ENG-972 to validate console filtering and add a server-side guard to reject cross-scope promo applies with clearer error (403 + msg).

devon: logging done: ledger rows updated, transfer tx TX-987654321, ticket INC-2026-482 updated.

maya: marking resolved from support side, will reopen if customer reports anything else."
